We need respond likely code HTML. Need build self-contained scene. Need infer desired. Need provide complete HTML using only three core module CDN, no addons. Need camera controls directly. Need buoy tender with stern crane and working deck. Need likely visually rich interactive. We should craft single HTML with CSS JS module. Need maybe explain save as index.html. Need ensure only import three.module.min.js. Implement orbit controls manually pointer/wheel. Scene: ocean, buoy tender boat, stern crane, working deck, maybe crane articulated, winch, railings, cabin, mast, navigation lights, wake, buoy. Need self-contained.

Need be careful Three.js API r160. Use import * as THREE from URL. No addons. Need code robust.

Let's design.

HTML full viewport, overlay title, controls hint, buttons maybe crane toggle, camera presets. Scene canvas.

Three scene:
- renderer antialias, shadows, tone mapping, sRGB.
- camera perspective.
- fog.
- sky background maybe gradient via CSS? renderer alpha true and CSS gradient. But scene background maybe Color. Could use large sky dome shader? Only core. Simpler scene.background = Color and fog.
- ocean plane with custom ShaderMaterial? "only Three.js core" okay. Use PlaneGeometry rotated, shader waves. But custom shader no lights. Could use MeshPhysicalMaterial and animate vertices CPU? Better shader with vertex displacement and fragment color, but shadows not receive. Ocean can be shader. Need visual.
- water plane 200x200 segments 100, rotate -PI/2. Shader vertex uses position x/y? Plane geometry local XY, after rotation. Vertex shader displacement based on position and time. Need normal approximate. Fragment gradient and specular. Could use MeshStandardMaterial with onBeforeCompile? More complexity. ShaderMaterial with fog? no. Fine.
- horizon maybe sky.
- boat group.

Boat orientation: length along Z, bow +Z, stern -Z. Hull custom shape via Lathe? Need recognizable. Use ExtrudeGeometry shape side profile? Better custom BufferGeometry hull with cross sections. Build hull as shape extruded along z? Shape in x-y, extrude z, but boat cross-section. Could create hull using vertices rings along z with widths and bottom y. Build rings:
z positions [-4.2 stern, -3.5, -1, 1.5, 3.5, 4.4 bow], half widths [0.75,0.95,1.05,1.0,0.65,0.05], top y=0.55, bottom y varies 0.25? Need closed hull.
Construct vertices for each ring: port top (-w,0.55,z), starboard top (w,0.55,z), port chine (-w*0.72,-0.15,z), keel-ish (0,-0.55,z). Connect quads. Add top deck shape maybe ShapeGeometry.
Could use ExtrudeGeometry of top plan shape? Hull custom enough.
Need deck working area. Main deck box/plane at y .58, z maybe 0.2, dimensions 2.1 x 3.8. But hull top shape. Use Shape with points x,z? ShapeGeometry lies XY, rotate x. Could create deck as Shape in x,z via BufferGeometry manually. Simpler BoxGeometry(1.8,0.12,3.4) at y .62 z .2, but corners may extend. Use shape polygon: points (-.95,-1.8),(.95,-1.8),(1.0,1.5),(.75,1.9),(-.75,1.9),(-1,1.5) in x,z. ShapeGeometry then rotateX(Math.PI/2)? Shape coordinates x,y; after rotateX(-PI/2), y maps z? rotation x -90: y' = z? Formula y'= y cos - z sin = 0, z'= y sin + z cos = -y. So use shape y=-z. Or just use custom triangulated polygon via ShapeGeometry and rotateX(-PI/2), then adjust. We'll create shape points x, -z. rotateX(-PI/2), position y .62.

Hull material navy, deck tan/gray.

Cabin forward at z 1.25, white box 1.65x1.25x1.65, roof, windows, door, antenna, radar, mast.
Stern crane at z=-2.2, pedestal, boom. Need articulated working crane. Build cylinders between points helper. Base cylinder, rotating house, boom segments. Use group hierarchy:
craneBase group at (0,0.7,-2.25)
turntable cylinder.
boom pivot group at y 1.15.
boom lower segment from local (0,0,0) to (0,2.2,0.2) maybe angled backward? Need crane reach over stern. Use cylinderBetween in local coordinates.
Could use group with lower boom along vector. Helper cylinderBetween(a,b,r,mat,parent) creates cylinder oriented y to direction.
Hierarchy:
base at stern.
house group at y .9.
boomPivot at y 1.25.
lower boom from (0,0,0) to (0,2.1,0.15) (slightly aft? z negative). upper boom pivot at end, segment from (0,0,0) to (0,1.8,-0.25) maybe.
hook cable from upper tip down to hook.
Need animate crane: boomPivot.rotation.z maybe? Since local y vector, rotation z changes x. But crane should lift. Use rotation.x? In Three, local y rotated around z gives x. rotation.z = -0.25. Upper segment rotation.z maybe 0.1. Hook y animate.
Could make cable line/cylinder and hook torus.
Crane house and cables.

Working deck: winch at stern port side, coiled rope torus, bollards, cleats, life ring, tool chest, coiled hose, crates, railings. Need visible.

Railings along sides and bow, posts and top rails. Use cylinders. Stern opening maybe crane.

Stern crane and working deck clearly.

Environment: buoy nearby maybe orange buoy, dock? "buoy tender" perhaps boat servicing buoy. Add buoy in water near stern, orange/white, with rope from crane to buoy. This sells scene. Buoy group at x=3.2,z=-1.5, cylinder body, cone top, light. Rope line from crane hook to buoy. But if hook animation, rope dynamic. Could update line geometry each frame. Add buoy bob.

Maybe tender near small dock? User only asks scene. Add buoy nearby.

Camera controls custom:
pointerdown, pointermove, pointerup; spherical coordinates around target. wheel zoom. right? implement.
Need avoid UI.
Buttons: overview, crane, reset maybe toggle crane animation.
Could include "Crane: working" status.

Need self-contained HTML. Use CSS.

Need ensure no external assets. Use procedural textures? CanvasTexture for deck markings maybe. Could create canvas texture for hull? Not necessary. But visual quality.
